description: Issue a ZATCA credit note (document type 381) against a cleared or reported invoice. Omit lines for the remaining full refundable balance, or provide positive partial-refund lines that do not exceed the parent's remaining quantities and amounts. Supply a stable idempotencyKey so agent/network retries cannot create a duplicate credit note.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable unique key for this refund intent. Reuse the same value when retrying the same request; use a new value for a different refund.

invoiceId.description: ID of the parent invoice to credit (must be in 'cleared' or 'reported' status)

lines.description: Lines to credit. Omit for a full refund of all parent invoice lines.

discount.description: Fixed discount amount for the entire credited line

unitPrice.description: Must be positive — credit note amounts are always positive

vatexCode.description: ZATCA VATEX exemption reason code (e.g. VATEX-SA-32). Required when vatCategory is Z, E, or O.

reasonCode.description: Reason for the credit note. Default: 'return'

name: create_credit_note
